title: build: pin fixed Brotli source for record reproduction
author: khai-oai
body:
Record reproduction currently installs an unpinned native Brotli package. Pin the six record requirements and the rerun helper to the immutable upstream source containing [the block-switch decoder fix](https://github.com/google/brotli/commit/0ed4268a4401abcb4472096340477cf4af7d1a2b), with a SHA-256 check. The setup note explains the compiler requirement and how to refresh existing environments, since upstream still reports version 1.2.0.

Validated the source build and install in a fresh Python 3.12 environment with uv, the installed decoder round trip, all six requirement pins, and the generated rerun command's Python/shell syntax. Training, GPU runs, and the full dependency environment were not run. Submission training code and historical results are unchanged.
